insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 44% women's / 38% men's. Alo skews 53% women's, Gymshark 21% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +8% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (150) vs Lululemon (113). Vuori leads by 37.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 46% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1344 vs 943 products. A 43% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 564 products. Behind Gymshark (1069).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 489 products vs Lululemon's 390. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 24,954 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 3,511 = 12% share of tracked catalog.
